entries.d7cd7051a3cff0ff: The company states that, as "a corporate group useful for the 'further evolution' of living and business," through energy such as natural gas, electricity and LPG and related services, and products and services such as urban development, materials and information, it aims to create value for customers, society, shareholders and employees. entries.dfc2cb98fe93f8a8: In Japan, the company produces city gas from raw materials such as LNG, delivers it through pipelines, and sells it. LNG transport is carried out for the company by Osaka Gas International Transport Inc., and Osaka Gas Gorgon Pty Ltd in Australia sells LNG to the company. Electricity is sold to the company by Senboku Natural Gas Power Generation Co., Ltd., Nakayama Nagoya Joint Power Generation Co., Ltd., Himeji Natural Gas Power Generation Co., Ltd., and others. At the Himeji Natural Gas Power Plant, Unit 1 (power generation capacity of about 620,000 kW) began commercial operation in January 2026, and Unit 2 (same, about 620,000 kW) in May 2026. Overseas, Sabine Energy Inc. produces and develops shale gas in Texas, United States, and the company is also involved in the Freeport liquefaction base (LNG) in the United States and natural gas businesses in Australia. In India, DAIGAS SJ CGD PTE. LTD. invests in a city gas business. Outside energy, there are real estate development and leasing, software development and information processing services, and manufacture and sale of fine materials, carbon material products, and activated carbon.
